messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the GPU autoscale postmortem. goal: assign owners for remediation items and agree on a short cadence so we close the loop. please claim.

maya: PROPOSED ACTIONS:
1) quota tiering + burst tokens -> implement per-project burst token pool (default 2 tokens) + soft-tier quotas to absorb short spikes (owner: lydia).
2) eviction circuit breaker -> add circuit breaker that pauses non-critical batch jobs when eviction_rate > 0.8/min for 5m (owner: tony).
3) scheduler backpressure -> implement a backpressure signal from node exporter to scheduler so packing thresholds adapt to node memory pressure (owner: sam).
4) rolling headroom audits -> run weekly 24h headroom audit for 4 weeks and publish summary (owner: lydia).
5) runbook + dashboard -> update surge-runbook with new play actions and create an "eviction incident" dashboard (owner: maya).

maya: timeline: protos/PRs by Thu EOD, tests + sim next Fri, small canary the following Tue. closure after 3-week observation.

lydia: ill own the burst tokens and weekly audits. will sketch a design doc and open a PR for token accounting.

tony: taking the eviction circuit breaker. quick note: will need a flag to mark jobs as critical vs batch - propose annotation job.critical=true.
sam: scheduler backpressure sounds good. i'll wire node mem pressure metric -> scheduler scoring and run a 6-run perf sweep.

maya: S3 traces for sims: s3://redwood-incidents/postmortem/2026-03-burst-traces-v4.tar.lz4 (anonymized). lydia/tony ping when you start so we can stream logs.

ops-bot: ci: burst-token-proto created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4401 (author: lydia)

lydia: PR opened ^. includes token accounting, metrics emit (burst_tokens_used), and a feature gate. unit tests included. requesting reviews from infra and billing folks.

tony: circuit-breaker design doc: https://go.redwood/eviction-cb-944. plan: breaker triggers if eviction_rate > 0.8/min AND mem_pressure > 75% for 5m; breaker will pause queued batch jobs and surface alert.

sam: created perf sweep issue: https://go.redwood/scheduler-backpressure-997 
params: mem_pressure_thresholds=[65,70,75], packing_defaults=[0.62,0.66,0.7], run_length=2h

lydia: started 24h audit on dev-grid. uploading artifacts to /sim-results/3314159265-audit.tar.gz. early signal: burst tokens absorbed ~60% of short spikes, reducing transient evictions.

maya: good. can we define canary abort criteria? i propose: eviction_rate > 1/min OR p99 uplift > 12% OR burst_tokens_exhausted for >10% of window.

ton y: noted (typo fix: tony). circuit-breaker will default to enabled=false (feature flag) and enabled in canary only.

ops-bot: canary-runner: scheduled canary on prod-canary-11 (id: cr-3314159265) -> stages: smoke 20m, soak 2h, full 6h.

ops-bot: canary: smoke complete (20m) \u2014 no immediate evictions, burst_token_use=0.4 avg.

sam: soaking 90m: mem_pressure stable, p99 +1.7%, packing drift within expected.

lydia: audit mid-report: burst tokens prevented 3 micro-evictions during soak, tokens remaining in pool. full audit to follow.

ops-bot: canary: full stage complete (6h) \u2014 status=PASS. metrics: eviction_rate=0, p99 +2.4%, burst_tokens_exhausted=false, circuit-breaker not triggered.

maya: great. next steps: lydia -> merge burst-token PR after 2 approvals and schedule weekly audits; tony -> open PR for circuit-breaker with tests; sam -> post final perf sweep and recommended thresholds; maya -> update runbook and publish dashboard.

lydia: will merge once infra review is in. scheduling audits now.

tony: will open PR today, including annotation gate job.critical and a small e2e test harness.

sam: perf sweep results: recommend mem_pressure_threshold=70, start_pack=0.66 with cost_guard=6%. posting the matrix in the issue.

maya: scheduling 15-min check-ins Tue/Wed for first 2 weeks (owners rotate: week1 lydia, week2 sam). after 2 clean weeks we close actions.

lydia: final audit report uploaded: https://drive.redwood/sim-reports/3314159265-audit.pdf \u2014 tl;dr: burst-token model works, recommended default tokens=2, max_burst_window=90s.

maya: thanks everyone. i'll create the closure ticket and mark items as in-progress -> closing after observation window. :white_check_mark:
